swing_confirmation: strict extremum, known only at second right completed close
trend: last two confirmed daily highs and lows, both rising or both falling
breakout_confirmation: inherited v1 breakout then next completed 60m close holds original breakout level
retest_confirmation: after frozen breakout all interim closes hold its level, at least one lower-volume touching bar, latest close exceeds preceding high with inherited volume confirmation
upper_reference: nearest of last two confirmed daily swing highs strictly above entry observation price
reward_risk: structural distance only, no expected return, no invented target
confirmation_explanation: confirmation_level freezes the prior breakout threshold; level remains the current rolling threshold
